findings.check: every corporate action carries an ISIN
findings.detail: an action with no ISIN cannot be joined to a price series, so it silently never applies

findings.check: every corporate action was parsed into a multiplier
findings.detail: an unparsed action is stored, visible, and has no effect on any price

findings.check: every factor input carries an observation time
findings.detail: without one there is no way to say what was knowable when

findings.check: no factor input was observed in the future

fundamentals_history.reason: No point-in-time fundamentals table exists. Valuation and quality inputs are fetched live from Yahoo at scoring time, which returns the statement as it reads today, not as it read on the date being scored.
fundamentals_history.consequence: No historical fundamentals PIT audit is possible, and no backtest using these factors can claim to be point-in-time. Only the price and corporate-action layer is PIT.
